host.activities.help: With no destination set, the city from the property address is used. The Destination field accepts a city name or the URL of the GetYourGuide page for that destination; pasting the URL is the reliable option, because a plain search depends on the country the guest connects from. A GetYourGuide link pasted here is rewritten with Portaki's affiliate id. A notice stating that these are partner links is shown automatically under the list, on the guest side.

host.tiqets.enabled: Show Tiqets tickets in the guidebook
host.tiqets.help: The search starts from the property's position. A note naming the source (Tiqets) and saying these are partner links is shown automatically under the list for guests. Booking happens on Tiqets.
host.tiqets.status.missingCoordinates: The property has no position on the map, so Tiqets can't search around it. Complete the property address.
host.tiqets.status.missingKey: No Tiqets key could be used: neither yours nor Portaki’s. Add your Tiqets partner key under “Services this module calls” below, or try again later. Nothing shows to guests.
host.tiqets.status.ready: Tickets are loaded from Tiqets and refreshed daily.
host.viator.enabled: Show Viator activities in the guidebook
host.viator.help: The search covers the property's city. Only Portaki’s key is used: Viator’s terms don’t allow its content to be shown under another key. A note naming the source (Viator) and saying these are partner links is shown automatically under the list for guests. Booking happens on Viator.
host.viator.status.missingCity: The property address doesn't give its city, so Viator can't search for activities. Complete the property address.
host.viator.status.missingKey: Portaki’s Viator key isn’t available right now. Nothing shows to guests; the section comes back on its own as soon as it is.
host.viator.status.ready: Activities are loaded from Viator and refreshed daily.
